_readme: Java worlds for /minecraft/java/worlds, rendered by mc-worlds.js. New world = new entry at the end with the next id; ids are permanent (share links use #world-<id>) and never renumbered. version / players: only what the creator states on the download page (MC Version field or their own text, never a commenter), else "". players: "1+" = solo or multiplayer. schematic: true when the download is a schematic, not a world folder. tags: keys from "tags" (filter chips, in this order); a new tag also gets a 16px item icon in "tagIcons" ("all" = the All chip).
